wp:term.wp:term_description: Daniel Wilson's career, they have not only honed their technical skills but also cultivated a talent for sharing knowledge and empowering others. Their engaging speaking style and ability to break down complex concepts into digestible insights make them a captivating presenter.

With a keen eye for aesthetics and a passion for user-centric design, Ethan has earned acclaim for his ability to transform complex ideas into intuitive and visually stunning interfaces. Through meticulous attention to detail and a deep understanding of user behavior.

As a seasoned content creator, John brings a wealth of experience and creativity to the table. From crafting compelling narratives to producing visually stunning multimedia content, John’s work transcends boundaries and resonates with audiences far and wide.

Kevin Harris has dedicated his career to helping individuals navigate the challenges of mental health with empathy and expertise. Through his clinical practice, research endeavors, and advocacy efforts, Kevin Harris has become a trusted authority in the field of psychiatry.

Michael has risen through the ranks to become a true titan of industry. From humble beginnings to commanding boardrooms, his entrepreneurial spirit and strategic acumen have propelled him to the pinnacle of success, earning him accolades and admiration from peers and competitors alike.

Rachel has cultivated a dedicated following by sharing his unique perspective, insights, and experiences with authenticity and sincerity. Whether he's exploring the latest trends, advocating for important causes, or sharing personal anecdotes, Sergio's content resonates deeply with his audience, leaving a lasting impact.

Tuition Fees

Affordable tuition fees at Upstudy University

At Upstudy University, we are dedicated to offering an affordable education while maintaining academic excellence, ensuring opportunities for students from all walks of life. Plan Details

Undergraduate Programs

School of Humanities

  • Full-Time Tuition (per semester): $265
  • Part-Time Tuition (per credit): $150

School of Engineering

  • Full-Time Tuition (per semester): $280
  • Part-Time Tuition (per credit): $160

Postgraduate Programs

School of Education

  • Full-Time Tuition (per semester): $320
  • Part-Time Tuition (per credit): $185

Additional Fees

  • Library Access Fee (per semester): $100
  • Lab Fee (for applicable courses): $85

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: upstudy
item.content:encoded:
What is privacy policy?

A privacy policy is a legal document that explains how a website, app, or business collects, uses, shares, and protects personal information provided by its users or customers. It is a crucial aspect of data privacy and user trust, as it informs individuals about the types of data collected, the purposes for which the data is used, and the rights users have regarding their personal information.

Things you create or provide to us

When you create a Google Account, you provide us with personal information that includes your name and a password. You can also choose to add a phone number or payment information to your account. Even if you aren’t signed in to a Google Account, you might choose to provide us with information — like an email address to communicate with Google or receive updates about our servicesWe also collect the content you create, upload, or receive from others when using our services. This includes things like email you write and receive, photos and videos you save, docs and spreadsheets you create, and comments you make on YouTube videos.

Information we collect as you use our services

We collect information about the apps, browsers, and devices you use to access Google services, which helps us provide features like automatic product updates and dimming your screen if your battery runs low.The information we collect includes unique identifiers, browser type and settings, device type and settings, operating system, mobile network information including carrier name and phone number, and application version number. We also collect information about the interaction of your apps, browsers, and devices with our services, including IP address, crash reports, system activity, and the date, time, and referrer URL of your request.
  • Terms you search for
  • Videos you watch
  • Views and interactions with content and ads
  • Voice and audio information
  • People with whom you communicate or share content
If you use our services to make and receive calls or send and receive messages, we may collect call and message log information like your phone number, calling-party number, receiving-party number, forwarding numbers, sender and recipient email address, time and date of calls and messages, duration of calls, routing information, and types and volumes of calls and messages.

When this policy applies

This Privacy Policy applies to all of the services offered by Google LLC and its affiliates, including YouTube, Android, and services offered on third-party sites, such as advertising services. This Privacy Policy doesn’t apply to services that have separate privacy policies that do not incorporate this Privacy Policy.

Changes to this policy

We change this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without your explicit consent. We always indicate the date the last changes were published and we offer access to archived versions for your review. If changes are significant, we’ll provide a more prominent notice (including, for certain services, email notification of Privacy Policy changes).

item.title: FAQs
item.dc:creator: upstudy
item.content:encoded:
Frequently Ask Questions (FAQ)

What is this theme designed for?

This theme is specifically designed for educational institutions, online courses, schools, universities, and e-learning platforms. If you want to build a Education or E-learning website Upstudy is a perfect theme.

Is this theme compatible with Elementor?

Yes, this theme is fully compatible with Elementor, offering drag-and-drop customization, pre-designed templates, Easy integration for easy website building.

Why do we need to use LMS plugins?

LMS (Learning Management System) plugins are essential for managing online courses efficiently. They allow you to create, organize, and sell courses, manage student enrollment, track progress, and offer interactive features like quizzes, certificates, and discussion forums. Additionally, LMS plugins support live classes (Zoom/Google Meet), automated notifications, and gamification to enhance learning experiences. If you want to build a professional e-learning platform, using an LMS plugin like Tutor LMS, LearnPress, LearnDash, or MasterStudy is highly recommended.

Do you offer a free trial for Upstudy Theme?

No, We do not offer free trials. However, if you purchase Upstudy Education WordPress Theme and decide within 30 days that it’s not the right fit for your project, you can request a refund as per our refund policy. We encourage you to reach out to our support team if you face any issues so we can assist you in making the most of our theme.

What types of support are available for users?

We offer comprehensive support to help you get the most out of our theme. Our support includes detailed documentation, a support forum for troubleshooting issues. All users get priority support with faster response times. If you encounter any difficulties, our team is ready to assist you with setup, customization, and technical concerns.

What technical support do you provide?

We offer 24/5 support primarily via forums and email, which we have found to be the most efficient means for both our customers and our support staff.

Why is a FAQ page important?

A FAQ page provides quick answers to common questions, reducing support requests, improving user experience, and boosting SEO. It helps build trust and makes information about courses, payments, and support easily accessible.

Which LMS plugins are compatible with this theme?

Our theme is fully compatible with six leading LMS plugins, ensuring flexibility for your e-learning platform. These include LearnPress, LearnDash, Tutor LMS, MasterStudy LMS, Sensei LMS, and LifterLMS. With these integrations, you can create, manage, and sell online courses effortlessly while taking advantage of features like quizzes, student progress tracking, and certificates. Whether you're building a school website, an online academy, or a training platform, our theme provides seamless compatibility with these LMS solutions.

Can I integrate Zoom Meeting for live classes?

Yes, you can easily integrate Zoom Meeting for live classes with our theme. This integration allows you to conduct interactive live sessions, enhancing the learning experience for students and instructors. With compatible Zoom Event plugin, you can schedule, manage, and join live classes seamlessly, making your educational platform more engaging.

Do you provide theme updates?

Yes, we provide regular updates with new features, improvements, and security fixes. Our theme is continuously updating with major or minor bug fixes.

Is there documentation available?

Yes, comprehensive documentation is available to help you set up and customize your website. It covers installation, configuration, and troubleshooting, ensuring a smooth experience as you build your educational platform.

Does the theme supports child theme?

Yes, our theme fully supports child themes. You can create a child theme to make customizations without affecting the core theme files, ensuring easy updates and preserving your modifications.

Yes, this theme is fully compatible with Elementor, offering drag-and-drop customization, pre-designed templates, Easy integration for easy website building.<\/p>","_id":"9c59810"},{"accordion_title":"Why do we need to use LMS plugins?","accordion_content":"

LMS (Learning Management System) plugins are essential for managing online courses efficiently. They allow you to create, organize, and sell courses, manage student enrollment, track progress, and offer interactive features like quizzes, certificates, and discussion forums. Additionally, LMS plugins support live classes (Zoom\/Google Meet), automated notifications, and gamification to enhance learning experiences. If you want to build a professional e-learning platform, using an LMS plugin like Tutor LMS, LearnPress, LearnDash, or MasterStudy is highly recommended.<\/p>","_id":"adc5779"},{"accordion_title":"Do you offer a free trial for Upstudy Theme?","accordion_content":"

No, We do not offer free trials. However, if you purchase Upstudy Education WordPress Theme and decide within 30 days that it\u2019s not the right fit for your project, you can request a refund as per our refund policy. We encourage you to reach out to our support team if you face any issues so we can assist you in making the most of our theme.<\/p>","_id":"434bf77"},{"accordion_title":"What types of support are available for users?","accordion_content":"

We offer comprehensive support to help you get the most out of our theme. Our support includes detailed documentation, a support forum for troubleshooting issues. All users get priority support with faster response times. If you encounter any difficulties, our team is ready to assist you with setup, customization, and technical concerns.<\/p>","_id":"c94179b"},{"accordion_title":"What technical support do you provide?","accordion_content":"

We offer 24\/5 support primarily via forums and email, which we have found to be the most efficient means for both our customers and our support staff.<\/p>","_id":"9cb7222"}],"background_background":"classic","accordion_title_active_color":"#FFFFFF","active_background_background":"classic","active_background_color":"#1CB098","accordion_icon_color":"#222222","accordion_active_icon_color":"#FFFFFF"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"upstudy-accordion"}],"isInner":true},{"id":"3b50310","elType":"container","settings":{"flex_direction":"column","content_width":"full","width":{"unit":"%","size":"50"},"width_tablet":{"unit":"%","size":100,"sizes":[]},"width_mobile":{"unit":"%","size":"","sizes":[]},"padding":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[{"id":"70cc741","elType":"widget","settings":{"content_width":"full","upstudy_accordion_list":[{"accordion_title":"Why is a FAQ page important?","accordion_content":"A FAQ page provides quick answers to common questions, reducing support requests, improving user experience, and boosting SEO. It helps build trust and makes information about courses, payments, and support easily accessible.","_id":"fb250d3"},{"accordion_title":"Which LMS plugins are compatible with this theme?","accordion_content":"Our theme is fully compatible with six leading LMS plugins, ensuring flexibility for your e-learning platform. These include LearnPress, LearnDash, Tutor LMS, MasterStudy LMS, Sensei LMS, and LifterLMS. With these integrations, you can create, manage, and sell online courses effortlessly while taking advantage of features like quizzes, student progress tracking, and certificates. Whether you're building a school website, an online academy, or a training platform, our theme provides seamless compatibility with these LMS solutions.","_id":"9c59810"},{"accordion_title":"Can I integrate Zoom Meeting for live classes?","accordion_content":"Yes, you can easily integrate Zoom Meeting for live classes with our theme. Frequently Asked Questions

Why is collaborative learning so important?

Employees often learn from each other, and a majority of learning in an organization is informal learning – or learning in the flow of work. It’s important to encourage and capture organization-wide collaboration for increased.

What kind of support do you offer?

All customers receive access to start-up guides, documentation, community forums, and help desk via the LearnDash Support site. Please see our Support Policy for additional details.

What technical support do you provide?

We offer 24/5 support primarily via forums and email, which we have found to be the most efficient means for both our customers and our support staff.

item.title: Team Single
item.dc:creator: upstudy
item.content:encoded:
David Carter

Department Of Political Science

Hello, I'm David Carter, a dedicated educator and researcher in the field of Political Science with over a decade of experience in academia. As a Senior Lecturer in the Department of Political Science, I specialize in comparative politics, international relations, and public policy.

Experience: 12 years

Email: your.mail@gmail.com

Education: Ph.D. in Political Science

Phone: +91 258 754 523

Website: www.devthrow.com

Facebook-f X-twitter Instagram Pinterest-p

Subjects & Expertise

I specialize in a wide range of subjects within Political Science, focusing on comparative politics, international relations, and public policy. My expertise extends to political theory, governance, and global diplomacy, allowing students to explore the complexities of political structures and decision-making processes. I am particularly interested in public administration, political ideologies, and the impact of policy-making on society.

Through my research and teaching, I strive to provide a deep understanding of political institutions, international conflicts, and the evolving nature of global governance, helping students develop critical thinking and analytical skills essential for navigating today’s political landscape.

Educational Background

I hold a Ph.D. in Political Science, along with a Master’s in International Relations and a Bachelor’s in Political Science from Upstudy University. Throughout my academic journey, I have focused on understanding the dynamics of political systems.My research and studies have equipped me with the knowledge to analyze comparative politics, international relations, and the role of governments in shaping societies.

Skills & Expertise

Effective Communication90% Curriculum Design75% Public Policy Analysis82%

item.title: Open To The Armies
item.dc:creator: upstudy
item.content:encoded:
We’ve applied the latest neuroscience for accelerated learning. Our process, programs, podcasts, and products unleash your brain’s own superpowers. Finish a book 3x faster through speed reading (and remember every part of it), learn a new language in record time, and master new skills with ease. These are just a few of the life-changing self-help benefits. That’s why the Kwik Brain process starts with unmasking assumptions, habits, and procrastinations that stifle you, redrawing the borders and boundaries of what you think is possible. It teaches you how to identify what you want in every aspect of your life.

  • Your brain is like a supercomputer and your thoughts program it to run.
  • Uncovering what motivates you is the key that opens up limitless mental capacity.
  • We’ve applied the latest neuroscience for accelerated learning.
item.excerpt:encoded:
For over 25 years, Jim Kwik has worked closely with successful men and women who are at the top in their fields as actors, athletes, CEOs, and business leaders from all walks of life to unlock their true potential. In this groundbreaking book, he reveals the science-based practices.

Your brain is like a supercomputer and your thoughts program it to run. That’s why the Kwik Brain process starts with unmasking assumptions, habits, and procrastinations that stifle you, redrawing the borders and boundaries.

Finish a book 3x faster through speed reading (and remember every part of it), learn a new language in record time, and master new skills with ease. These are just a few of the life-changing self-help benefits. That’s why the Kwik Brain process starts with unmasking assumptions, habits, and procrastinations that stifle you, redrawing the borders and boundaries of what you think is possible. It teaches you how to identify what you want in every aspect of your life.

  • Your brain is like a supercomputer and your thoughts program it to run.
  • Uncovering what motivates you is the key that opens up limitless mental capacity.
  • We’ve applied the latest neuroscience for accelerated learning.

item.title: Devoted To Robots
item.dc:creator: upstudy
item.content:encoded:
We’ve applied the latest neuroscience for accelerated learning. Our process, programs, podcasts, and products unleash your brain’s own superpowers. Finish a book 3x faster through speed reading (and remember every part of it), learn a new language in record time, and master new skills with ease. These are just a few of the life-changing self-help benefits. That’s why the Kwik Brain process starts with unmasking assumptions, habits, and procrastinations that stifle you, redrawing the borders and boundaries of what you think is possible. It teaches you how to identify what you want in every aspect of your life.

  • Your brain is like a supercomputer and your thoughts program it to run.
  • Uncovering what motivates you is the key that opens up limitless mental capacity.
  • We’ve applied the latest neuroscience for accelerated learning.
item.excerpt:encoded:
For over 25 years, Jim Kwik has worked closely with successful men and women who are at the top in their fields as actors, athletes, CEOs, and business leaders from all walks of life to unlock their true potential. In this groundbreaking book, he reveals the science-based practices.

Your brain is like a supercomputer and your thoughts program it to run. That’s why the Kwik Brain process starts with unmasking assumptions, habits, and procrastinations that stifle you, redrawing the borders and boundaries.
